page.layout: Running head at top: page number "132" left and "Roma Irreconciliabilis." right. One text column at centre-right. Left margin holds two marginal notes ("Iren.l.2.s.1." and "Matt.16.9."). Catchword "temus," at bottom right below the last line.

main_text.p: rumoribus circumgestari, & aereo hoc fluxu, ad sera nepotum secula deriuari solet? Quale est (vt sapienter Irenaeus) Prophetarum, & Domini & Apostolorum,relinquentes nos vocem, attendere his nihil sani garrientibus? Vel (si istud expedit) quàm mihi nunc frustra eitis Gr.ελεγχος οξεια, Prophetae, Apostoli, Euangelistę? Et quod ille olim de vnguento, εις την ενταφιασμον Matt.26.9. Permiciosa sunt haec quidem Ecclesiae, & à diuinae tum sapientiae, tum bonitatis gloriâ, non parum abhorrentia Paradoxa; Teneant ergo ista qui audiunt, nos profecto nunquam committemus,

page.notes: Left margin notes: "Iren.l.2.s.1." (beside "Quale est") and "Matt.26.9." (beside "vnguento"). The Greek fragments are reproduced approximately; the first Greek phrase after "eitis" and the Greek after "vnguento" are doubtful. The text is in a small, worn print; words in the second line of the final paragraph ("audiunt") may be misread and should be checked against the scan. The last line before the catchword "temus," reads "committemus," with the catchword completing the word.
